title: drag-lint
summary: This page documents the "View > Tool Windows > drag-lint" menu entry -- the main drag-lint dockable tool window
intro: Read this to find the main drag-lint dockable panel. It opens from View > Tool Windows > drag-lint, and is the same panel as the one reached through the drag-lint menu.

steps: The main drag-lint dockable panel opens (the same panel as from the drag-lint menu)

questions.ask: Where is the main drag-lint panel?
